entities.name: RRC Connection Resume
entities.description: Procedure to resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s), DRB(s) and multicast MRB(s) or perform an RNA update. Also used to initiate SDT in RRC_INACTIVE.

entities.name: RRCResumeRequest/RRCResumeRequest1
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to request RRC connection resume.

entities.name: RRCResume
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE in response to RRCResumeRequest.

entities.name: RRCResumeComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to complete RRC connection resume procedure.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE can initiate connection resume procedure.

entities.name: Conditions for NR sidelink communication/discovery resume
entities.description: Conditions under which RRC connection is resumed for NR sidelink communication/discovery, including upper layer configuration, data availability, and SIB12 configuration checks.

entities.name: Conditions for L2 U2N Relay UE resume
entities.description: Conditions for RRC connection resume when L2 U2N Relay UE receives messages from L2 U2N Remote UE via SL-RLC0 or SL-RLC1.

entities.name: Conditions for V2X sidelink communication resume
entities.description: Conditions for RRC connection resume for V2X sidelink communication as specified in TS 36.331.

entities.name: Conditions for initiating SDT
entities.description: Conditions for initiating Small Data Transmission in RRC_INACTIVE state, including upper layer request, sdt-Config configuration, pending data mapping, and lower layer conditions.

entities.name: sdt-Config
entities.description: Configuration parameter for Small Data Transmission.

relations.description: RRC connection resume procedure begins with UE sending RRCResumeRequest message.
Network responds with RRCResume message during resume procedure.
UE completes resume procedure by sending RRCResumeComplete message.
RRC connection resume procedure is initiated when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
NR sidelink communication/discovery conditions guard when RRC connection resume procedure is initiated.
L2 U2N Relay UE conditions guard when RRC connection resume procedure is initiated.
V2X sidelink communication conditions guard when RRC connection resume procedure is initiated.
SDT initiation conditions guard when RRC connection resume procedure is used for Small Data Transmission.
SDT initiation condition requires sdt-Config to be configured.
